note: The voters, the fallback and the adjudicator, pinned. `voters` and `adjudicator` name entries of `models`, so swapping a voter is one line there. `provider` is the tag the OpenRouter endpoint listing gives the endpoint (models/<id>/endpoints), and the runner checks the listing at run time: the endpoint must exist, have the quantisation pinned here, and support every parameter sent. `temperature` and `reasoning` are sent only when not null, since the request requires every parameter it sends: Mistral's endpoint lists no `reasoning`, and the Anthropic route lists no `temperature`. `reasoning` is passed through as OpenRouter's object; the adjudicator thinks at low effort, and `max_tokens` (16000) includes the thinking. `provider_fallback` lists other pinned endpoints of the same model, in order, at the same quantisation or a more precise one than `provider`'s listing gives; the runner never switches to one mid-run: when `provider` keeps answering 429 or 5xx it stops and prints the command for a new run at the next one (`--again --endpoint TAG`). Pins from the listings of 2026-10-07.
